_note: Phonetic strings use Rime's real phonetic alphabet (docs.rime.ai/platform/rime-phonetic-alphabet): a digit (1=primary stress, 2=secondary stress, 0=unstressed) before every vowel, single-letter symbols, no separators. These are hand-built best-effort strings from standard English dictionary pronunciations, syntactically valid this time, but still NOT audio-verified. Before locking in evidence, verify/regenerate against a real reference recording using the Phonemize API (POST audio to https://optimize.rime.ai/phonemize) or the Pronunciation tool at rime.ai/dashboard/pronunciation.
